title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: Class P1 warm-up: recall the 10 new words and read your orange juice answer aloud
theme: Trial Lesson 2 · Warm-up for class P1
source: Pre-IELTS Trial Lesson 2, Daily Practice (Sunday 1/11, class day P1)
intro: P1 class from 17:00 to 19:00. Warm up for 15 minutes only, and bring a pen and notes to class. Deadline 23:30 the same day: complete and on time earns 10 Meow (class); late or half done earns 5 Meow. Do not look at the answers before you finish.

steps.title: Step 1 · Vocabulary recall
steps.instructions: Fill in the words or phrases from the box (prioritise · unwind · packed with · juggling · productive). Change the word form if needed.

items.label: I need to ____ my tasks: exams come first, then essays.
Cooking helps me ____ after a busy week.
Our class was ____ new students this term.
She is ____ three jobs at the moment.
items.explain: Sau am, is, are là động từ thêm -ing: juggling.

items.label: We finished everything today. It was a very ____ day.

steps.title: Step 2 · Speaking warm-up and voice note
steps.instructions: Say aloud the 10 new words, each with an example of your own (hectic, commute, keep up with, a sense of achievement, juggle, be packed with, unwind, productive, procrastinate, prioritise). Then read aloud the introduction and overview of the Saturday orange juice piece, once. Record 1 voice note.
lines: 1. Nói 10 từ mới, mỗi từ một ví dụ.
2. Đọc to introduction và overview bài orange juice của thứ 7, một lần.
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét phát âm, đuôi -ed và nhịp đọc.

send_today: Hoàn thành 2 bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 2 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
